contract_version: factory-contract-v2 (2026-08-12; B0 removed, packets view + panel-first)

confirmation_slice_definition.name: confirm_2025h2
confirmation_slice_definition.predicate: test_type = 'NT' AND outcome IN ('PASS','FAIL','PRS') AND test_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND test_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
confirmation_slice_definition.selection: u = hash(CAST(vehicle_id AS VARCHAR) || 'mp2026conf') / 2^64; include iff u < threshold pinned in the pre-registration
confirmation_slice_definition.status: DEFINITION EMITTED, NEVER BUILT BY THE DEFAULT PATH

packets.shape: long (one row per target x prior; zero-prior targets emit one NULL-prior row)

defects_json_states.null: detail unavailable, OR defect_payload_mode != 'rows'. NEVER read as 'no defect' (PREREG_CUBE_v2 §4).

rules.note: Whole-day blackout. 0 of 41,349 tests carry items; 2024-12-30 sits at 0.6268. completed_ts carries all 41,349 rows for the day, so the tests exist and items were expected. The ingested dft_test_item_extract_202412.csv is 279,587,213 bytes, byte-exact with DVSA's published member, so ingestion lost nothing and the publication is short. All 9,105 globally item-less fail-bearing 2024 tests fall on this single date. Measured 2026-08-13, ITEM_OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md 1.3, independently reproduced by lead.

Non-definitive outcomes (ABANDONED/ABORTED/ABORTED_VE) stopped carrying items at the results_extracts publisher boundary. Whole-population: 2015-2023 carried items on 7.94% to 14.98% of non-definitive tests, rising monotonically; 2024 = 0 of 255,216; 2025 = 0 of 256,054. A clean cliff on the schema-epoch boundary rather than a gradual decline, so this is a publication policy change, not data loss. Declared unavailable rather than expected_missing because these items were never published for this record class under this epoch. Measured 2026-08-13, ITEM_OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md 1.4, independently reproduced by lead.

ledger.resolution_order: cell rules first (most specific wins; they NEVER consult the join), then join, then the fail-bearing definitional impossibility, then the covered-cell residual.

measured.grain: staged vehicle_day atoms, per input year
measured.residual_note: inside a covered cell a PASS with zero items is undecidable; bounded by the same-cell fail-bearing miss rate (<=1.6e-5 measured whole-population). Not papered over: those rows are emitted as 'present_zero_defects' (certified cell) or 'assumed_zero_defects' (undeclared cell).
